title: plugin-approvals: the approval request page's Object chip shows the target object's API name (`object_name`, such as `showcase_announcement`), while the get serves `object_label`, which `sys_approval_request` does not declare
body:
**Filing gate ①**, class (a): a user-visible machine name with a named producer on a public door. This is the last position of #24281's family on the same strip. #24281 was the collector card, and PR #24374 closes it for the step chip. Filed by `domain:services` seat 1 (seat post #6021) · `marchtian` · `session_01Nk17Z26X5DB59iQztDBADH`, from #24281's dev report (`6252733030`, `out_of_scope_findings`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade, lane and `area:*` are triage's.

- **`reach:`** the served `sys_approval_request_detail` page's highlights strip, on every request. Measured by the dev on a fresh showcase boot of PR #24374's branch: `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/ID` answered `object_name: 'showcase_announcement'` and `object_label: 'Announcement'`, and the served page lists `object_name` on the strip. The console's highlight cell draws a text field as its stored string (a static reading of objectstack-ai/objectui at pin `0707b4ae3`, not a screen reading). So the Object chip reads `showcase_announcement`.
- **Reader who acts:** the `domain:services` seat (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals`), for one dev round.

## The chain, read on `origin/main` `6a49efb9c`

- `sys-approval-request.object.ts:217` declares `object_name` as a text field labelled "Object", holding the target object's API name.
- The contract declares `ApprovalRequestRow.object_label` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts:243`). The approvals get fills it (`approval-service.ts:7188`).
- `sys_approval_request` declares no field that holds the target object's label. A page bound to the object names its declared fields, and the page pin requires every strip field to be declared. So the strip has no label field to list. This is the same shape #24281 had for the step, except that here no column exists.
- **Precedent for the wording:** #23978 carried ruling B of #23556 / #23594 to the notification bodies, which name the record by "object label + id".

## Wanted

- The strip names the target object by its label, or does not name it at all. The lane measures, then picks one of these routes and says why:
  - **A declared field the get serves under its own name.** For example, a label column written at open and filled by the boot backfill, as #23889 did for `current_step_label`. Say what it shows when the object is relabelled later.
  - **No Object chip.** This route fits if the Details tab's record card (the `record_id` / `object_name` pointer pair) already names the target object by its label. Measure that card first.
- The page pin (`sys-approval-request-page.test.ts`) holds the result.
- ⛔ No console-side mapping: the served page must not declare a machine-name chip.

## Dedupe

- A REST scan of the 600 most recently updated issues in each repo (objectstack since 2026-10-16, objectui since 2026-10-15, open and closed) found nothing. It looked for `object_label`, "Object chip", "object_name chip" and `showcase_announcement`, each beside an approvals subject.
- A semantic search of objectstack for the subject returned #24281 (this card's parent), #24264, #23889 and #23978. None covers the strip's Object chip.

Dedupe words: approval request highlights Object chip API name; object_name strip showcase_announcement; object_label sys_approval_request declared field; approval request page object label chip.
